dart.description: Official Dart/Flutter MCP server: analyze/fix/format code, run tests, manage pub deps, launch and hot reload apps, read runtime errors, logs, and inspect widgets.

marionette.description: Drive a running Flutter app (debug/profile): see interactive elements, tap, type, scroll, swipe, screenshot, read logs, hot reload/restart.

stitch.description: Google Stitch: generate and edit UI screens and variants, capture/upload pages, and manage Stitch projects and design systems.
